name: Incentive For The Simple Marriage
benefit:
Financial Incentives: The scheme provides a financial incentive of Rs. 50,000.00 to eligible Simple Married Couples belonging to the SC community.
Promotes Simple Marriages: The scheme aims to promote the concept of simple marriages, which can help reduce the financial burden on families and promote equality in society.
Eligibility Criteria: The eligibility criteria for the scheme are straightforw
_eligibility_text:
1. Karnataka State Resident: The applicant must be a resident of Karnataka state.
1. SC Community: The applicant must belong to the SC community.
1. Family Income: The family income from all sources should not exceed Rs. 2 lakhs per annum.
1. Time Limit: The scheme is applicable only within 1 year of the marriage.
